  { id: 'ap2', name: 'Vegetable Spring Rolls', price: 155, category: 'Appetizers', image: 'https://via.placeholder.com/150/EEEEEE/808080?text=SpringR', averagePreparationTime: 10, description: 'Crispy rolls filled with vegetables.' },
